blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 022-69787301 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email care@nsdlbank.co.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://nsdlpayments.bank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nsdlpb.jiffy | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/nsdl-jiffy/id1519816505

No toll-free line and no SMS block shortcode are published; customer care is the chargeable Mumbai pair 022-42022100 / 022-69787301 (contact page labels them 'Banking:', available Monday-Sunday 9.00 am-9.00 pm). The blocking PDF's IVR flow: press 1 English / 2 Hindi, press 0 to report a lost card or suspicious transaction, press 1 to temporarily block or 2 to permanently block (then 1 to continue) - an SMS confirmation is sent to the registered mobile number. A separate 'Debit card (IVR)' line 02269160500 (Monday-Sunday 9.00 am-9.00 pm) carries 'Block Card - Temporary/Permanent' and 'To temporary block Debit card' among options the bank says are available 24X7. No overseas helpline is published. App path (NSDL Jiffy): Menu (3 lines, top left) > Cards > Manage Card > Temporary Block Card > Confirm; FAQ lists unblock at Card Section | Manage your card | Unblock, and a permanent block cannot be reversed. No separate netbanking block path is published - the PDF footer's www.nsdlbank.com redirects to nsdlpayments.bank.in, whose portal link is https://nsdljiffy.co.in/jiffyservice/home. Prepaid cards (separate product): +91 22-42022190 / +91 22-69787303, prepaid-card unauthorized-transaction reports to prepaid.service@nsdlbank.co.in. The bank's own pages direct fraud victims to the National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 and https://cybercrime.gov.in. Card products are RuPay Platinum and Visa Classic debit cards plus prepaid cards only - as a payments bank it issues no credit cards, so no credit section is recorded. Old npb.co.in domain no longer serves the bank's site; current domain identified from RBI's official Banks-in-India registry (nsdlpayments.bank.in).
